_review: T045 draft. English is final; Tamil needs native review.
showcase: Showcase: sample reviews, nothing is read from or sent to Google.
needApprover: Only a person who can approve replies can do this.
approvedHint: Approved. Nothing is public until you post it. Editing sends it back to draft.
failedHint: Google did not accept the reply. Nothing was posted. Approve again to retry.
source.ai: Suggested by AI. A person must read and approve it.
source.template: Suggested from a template. A person must read and approve it.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was posted.
err.not_found: This review is no longer available.
err.invalid_state: This reply has changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
err.invalid_input: The reply text is empty or too long.
err.not_connected: Google Business Profile is not connected.
err.token_rejected: Google rejected the access. Reconnect to continue.
err.post_failed: Google could not take the reply right now. Nothing was posted.
err.audit_failed: The action could not be recorded, so it was not done.
err.conflict: Someone else changed this reply. Reload and try again.
gate: Needs Google Business Profile API access
gateSub: Google gives these APIs to approved applications only. Until then the page shows sample data.
pickHelp: Only listings your Google account manages are shown. Reviews and daily performance are loaded for the one you pick.
